records.name: Vera Calmnow
records.biography_en: Vera Calmnow booked a place with The Compulsory Relaxation. I am relaxing as fast as I can. The incident report lists tiny hourglass and rolled yoga mat as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I am relaxing as fast as I can.

records.name: Drew Cucumber
records.biography_en: Drew Cucumber booked a place with The Compulsory Relaxation. They gave me the salad separately. The incident report lists two cucumber slices held away from face and facecloth as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: They gave me the salad separately.
